sharon-woods.mobility.1: Universally accessible playgrounds are located at: Francis RecreAcres Sharon Woods Winton Woods - Harper Meadows
Visitors can now use a Zero G-Chair Swing at Winton Woods, Sharon Woods, Lake Isabella, Woodland Mound, Miami Whitewater Forest, Shawnee Lookout and Embshoff Woods.
sharon-woods.cognitive.2: Contractors will start lowering Sharon Lake on Tuesday, October 27. The lake will remain lowered until Spring 2027.
Boat access to the lake will be restricted while the water is down.
The Snack Bar at Sharon Woods Harbor will be closed during the Harbor Revitalization project .
sharon-woods.mobility.3: 0.6 Miles Easy Shared-Use Trail Not Accessible
sharon-woods.mobility.4: 0.7 Miles Easy Shared-Use Trail Not Accessible
sharon-woods.mobility.5: 1.3 Mile Easy/Moderate Shared-Use Trail Not Accessible
fountain-square.mobility.1: The Fountain Square North Garage, located directly beneath the Square, features 600 spaces spread across four underground levels.
Pay stations are located next to the elevators on the Plaza level and Level 1 of the Garage.
fountain-square.chronic.1: Public restrooms are located on the west ramp leading up from Vine Street toward the parking garage portal.
They are open to the public from 6am to 11pm every day. In the instance that no evening event is programmed on the Square, restrooms will close at 4pm.
28 umbrellas – compliments of Strauss Troy – keep the plaza cool and comfortable when the sun is overhead. The umbrellas are mobile so you can put them right where you want them!
fountain-square.cognitive.1: Fountain Square is closed from 3:00 AM to 6:00 AM except for the purpose of entering and exiting the garage or adjacent buildings.
Call the Ambassador Hotline at (513) 623-3429 if you have questions or concerns, need directions or a map to a Downtown destination.
fountain-square.chronic.3: Restroom Attendants are also on duty inside the bathrooms during larger events.
Should one find the restroom closed during the hours it should be open, available Ambassadors would be happy to explain why, or open it up when possible.
great-wolf-lodge-mason.mobility.1: Accessible common area restrooms and water fountains
great-wolf-lodge-mason.mobility.3: Temporary use of wheelchairs are available through Guest Services on a first come, first serve basis.
great-wolf-lodge-mason.sensory.1: Closed captioning and/or transcripts available for certain attractions featuring audible entertainment, including our interactive live-action game MagiQuest
Equipment available upon request to assist with audibility needs
great-wolf-lodge-mason.cognitive.1: As part of this partnership, IBCCES helped us develop a sensory guide for each slide, pool, ride, attraction, show and activity found at Great Wolf Lodge.
We hope this downloadable guide provides a valuable and convenient tool for sensory-sensitive guests as they plan their visit to our resort.
great-wolf-lodge-mason.mobility.4: Accessible pathways from front desk to guestrooms, including accessible elevators to other floors of the hotel and common area corridors of 36” width or wider
